adjudication.rationale: In newly added `app/assets/javascripts/embed.js`, the IIFE runs immediately and does `var comments = document.getElementById('discourse-comments')` followed by `comments.appendChild(iframe);` with no null/DOM-ready check. If the script executes before the element exists (e.g., included in `<head>` or the host omits/misnames the container), `comments` is `null` and `appendChild` will throw a TypeError, breaking embedding.
